name: Stable
blurb: No shocks. Prices, rates and markets follow their normal course. Choosing this clears every shock that has not happened yet.

name: 2008: the financial crisis
blurb: A credit scare, a market crash, falling home prices, and the Bank of DAA cutting its rate to nearly zero, then a recovery.

events.headline: Credit markets wobble: stocks fall about 10%
Market crash: stocks and funds fall sharply
The Bank of DAA cuts its rate to 1.00%
The Bank of DAA cuts again, to 0.50%

name: 1981 Alberta: the oil bust
blurb: A sharp rate rise to the most the game allows (10%, well under the real 18%), a fall in home prices, a hard year for families, and rates easing.

events.headline: Rate shock: the Bank of DAA raises its rate to 10%
The oil bust hits: home prices in town fall 15%
Hard times: car repair bills hit the whole town
Rates ease: the Bank of DAA cuts its rate to 7%

name: 2022: the inflation spike
blurb: Prices jump 8% a year, the Bank of DAA raises its rate step by step, then inflation cools and home prices ease.

events.headline: Prices jump: inflation runs at 8% a year
The Bank of DAA raises its rate to 3%
The Bank of DAA raises its rate to 5%
The Bank of DAA raises its rate to 6%
Home prices in town cool: down 10%
